messages.author: 679cb36eb7570d4b
messages.subject: Problems installing aroma
parts:
Hi,

I tried to install the aroma package according to the instructions on
your website on my linux-64 machine, but got the following error:

> source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
Error in file(file, "r", encoding = encoding) :
cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "r", encoding = encoding) :
cannot open: HTTP status was '503 Service Unavailable'

I use R 2.7.2 and have installed several bioconductor packages using
the "source-install" method sucessfully. I am also behind a corporate
firewall and am generally able to access outside networks fine through
a proxy server. Any ideas what is going on here?

Thanks a lot,
Kavitha

parts: Hi.

On Tue, Sep 30, 2008 at 12:09 PM, kvenk <kavitha.v...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> I tried to install the aroma package according to the instructions on
> your website on my linux-64 machine, but got the following error:
>
>> source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
> Error in file(file, "r", encoding = encoding) :
> cannot open the connection
> In addition: Warning message:
> In file(file, "r", encoding = encoding) :
> cannot open: HTTP status was '503 Service Unavailable'
>
> I use R 2.7.2 and have installed several bioconductor packages using
> the "source-install" method sucessfully. I am also behind a corporate
> firewall and am generally able to access outside networks fine through
> a proxy server. Any ideas what is going on here?

I don't know, but either it was a one-time failure at the webserver
(but they are rare) or more likely some issue with your firewall/proxy
settings. It is also not clear what you mean by 'the "source-install"
method'. For troubleshooting, I'd suggest to:

* Try to connect to http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R in a web browser.
* Try to connect to http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R using 'wget' (your
on Linux so you probably have this one).
* Try to connect to http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R using
download.file("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R") inside R.
* Try do source("http://www.bioconductor.org/biocLite.R"). If that
works, but not source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R"), then there
is something in your firewall that give you permission to access the
former but not the latter.
* Talk to your corporate's sysadm.

Cheers

/Henrik

> Thanks a lot,
> Kavitha
>
> >
